source.title: Irish News, 4 June 1949, p. 3 ("Rural council election results"); Belfast News-Letter, 4 June 1949, p. 3 ("County and rural council results")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: INW 4 Jun 1949 p3: 'Only one division - Ardmore - was contested in the Derry Rural District Council area, and there Mr. Wm. Doherty (Anti-Partitionist), the retiring member, defeated Colonel John A. Crawford (U.) by 225 votes to 205'; BNL 4 Jun 1949 p3 'Ardmore division: W. Doherty (Nat), 225; Colonel J. A. Crawford'.

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Londonderry (Derry) rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. Two contests were nominated; John S. Browne (U.) withdrew in Middle Liberties, leaving Patrick G. Coyle returned unopposed. Only Ardmore was actually polled. The eleven unopposed members added from the nominations lists (Londonderry Sentinel, 19 May 1949, p. 6; Derry Journal, 18 May 1949), Tamnaherin from the Derry Journal list; full names checked against the Returning Officer's notice (Derry Journal, 8 June 1949, p. 1) (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Doherty, the retiring Anti-Partitionist member, defeated Colonel John A. Crawford (U.). Majority 20.
